transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess I'm just... I don't know. I don't really care about anything anymore. I used to do things, like art classes and board-game nights, but... I don't want to do them now. I used to hike. I even thought about going back to my soccer team, but... I just sit in my room now. Everything is just sort of slipping away, and I don't really care.
How long have you been feeling this way?
A while, I guess. Almost two years. It started... well, right after my divorce. That was about a year and eleven months ago. So... since then.
Have you noticed that you no longer take pleasure in activities you used to enjoy, like your art classes, hiking, or soccer?
Yeah... like I said. I just don't care about them anymore. None of it. I just... stay in my room.
Do you feel down or depressed most days, and does it last throughout the day?
Yeah... most days. I just... I wake up and there's this heavy feeling. Like a hollow space in my chest. It just kind of stays there all day. I don't really see a future outside of my apartment.
Have you found yourself feeling worthless or guilty, maybe even blaming yourself for things that aren't your fault?

I guess... yeah. I just... I end up replaying every little thing I did wrong. In the marriage, and... with my friends. It's just... I don't know. Sometimes I think they'd all be safer, or just... less burdened... if I was gone.
Have you had episodes of feeling this way before, or is this the first time you’ve felt this depressed over a long period?
I don't know... I guess I've felt down before. But... maybe not like this. I don't really remember.
Have you had periods of feeling this low or depressed before, or is this the first time you’ve felt this way for such a long stretch?

I mean... I guess it got really bad last summer. Like, constant. It hasn't really stopped since then... so, what is that? A year and some change? Four months, maybe? I don't know. It's just been a long time.
Before this most recent period of feeling down, have you had other times in your life when you felt similarly depressed, even if they didn’t last as long?
I... I don't really know. It's hard to remember before... before all this started. It just sort of all blends together.
Before your divorce and this current period of feeling down, did you ever have any other times in your life when you felt similarly depressed, even if it didn’t last this long?
I just... I don't know. Like I said, I really can't remember much from before. It's just... I don't think so. I don't know.
Before the period of feeling down that started around your divorce, can you recall any other distinct times in your life when you felt similarly depressed, even if they didn’t last as long?
I... I really can't say. I just... I don't remember. I told you, everything before last year is just... fuzzy. I don't think I did.
Before the period of feeling down that started around your divorce, did you ever have any distinct periods of time when you felt depressed, even if they didn't last very long?
I... I don't know how else to tell you. No. I don't remember anything like that before. I just... I already said that.

Before the period of depression that started around your divorce, did you ever have any other times in your life when you felt depressed enough that it affected your daily life, even if it didn’t last as long as this one?
I... I don't know what you want me to say. You keep asking me the exact same thing. I already told you no. I just don't have a different answer for you.

Before your divorce and this current period of feeling down, did you ever have any other times in your life when you felt so down or hopeless that it affected your life, even if it didn’t last very long?
I... I don't... Why do you keep asking me this? I don't have anything else to say. I don't remember any other times. Just... please stop asking me the same thing.
Before your divorce and this current period of feeling down, have you ever had any shorter periods where you felt depressed enough that it affected your daily life, even if it didn’t last very long?
I... I don't know what else to do here. You've asked me this four times now. I... I don't have a different answer. No. Just... no.
Before your divorce and this current period of feeling down, did you ever have any shorter periods where you felt depressed enough that it affected your daily life, even if it didn’t last very long?
I... I really don't understand what's happening right now. You just... you just asked me that. Again. I don't have a different answer for you. No. I didn't. I just want to move on.
